_note: Legacy marking-sheet Topic Reference labels -> app unit node id. Built 2026-08-14 from the 30 distinct labels found across Martina's 8 feedback sheets (May-Aug 2026). The labels drifted over two generations - flat labels in May, hierarchical 'Area -> Topic' from June - and Articles alone appeared under three different spellings. Going forward the Topic Reference column carries the APP UNIT NAME directly, so this table is only needed to retrofit sheets written before that decision. Validated by codex/check_marking_labels.py: every value must be a live on-path node.
_no_unit: A label mapped to null has no unit and must be left as plain text, unlinked. That is deliberate - a link that goes nowhere useful is worse than no link, and the blanks are what tell us which units to build.
